name: mermaid-render
description: Draws mermaid code blocks in Claude's replies as images in the terminal (kitty graphics protocol).

autoRender.title: Render automatically
autoRender.description: Render each mermaid block as soon as it is complete. Off: a [ Render diagram ] button under each block.

puppeteerConfig.title: Puppeteer config
puppeteerConfig.description: Optional path to a puppeteer JSON config passed to mmdc -p (e.g. an executablePath for a system Chromium).

theme.title: Mermaid theme
theme.description: The mermaid theme passed to mmdc -t.

background.title: Background
background.description: The image background passed to mmdc -b (a CSS color or transparent).

maxRows.title: Max rows inline
maxRows.description: The most terminal rows a diagram takes inline in the transcript; Expand shows it in a pane.
